messages:
maya: Heads up — nightly smallbatch E2E failed perf gate (p95 +22% vs baseline). job: https://ci.redwoodinfra/ci/9147

ci-bot: Build 9147 failed: perf-gate p95=254ms (baseline 209ms) — see artifacts at https://ci.redwoodinfra/artifacts/9147

liam: ack, grabbing artifacts

owen: can someone rerun with --env PERF_DEBUG=1? I can kick a rerun if no one's doing it

maya: thanks. I kicked a rerun but flagged it as manual. test name: tests/e2e/small_batch_autoscale.py::test_p95_latency

ci-bot: Rerun started by maya — rerun id 9147-r2

ci-bot: Rerun finished — p95=260ms, did not change :(

sam: hmm. did the test use the new batching heuristics CL?  https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/3821

liam: good call — that PR landed in last deploy. rolling back that change in local repro gives p95 208ms for me

owen: can you share the bisect range? I can try bisect on nightly runner

liam: range: a1b2c3 -> HEAD. suspect: batching/continuous_batching.go tweak

maya: if owen can bisect that'd be great. if it narrows to batching, we should hotfix or add guardrails

owen: starting bisect on aws-nightly-runner smallbatch job. command:
```
ci-bisect --job nightly-smallbatch --start a1b2c3 --end HEAD --metric p95 --threshold 1.1
```

ci-bot: Bisect job queued (id 1819)

ci-bot: Bisect step 1 complete — culprit narrowed to a1b2c3..d4e5f6

liam: d4e5f6 is the quantized-kv change + batching tweak. looks like interaction effect.

jen: pls upload perf flamegraphs and heap profiles before/after to the ticket. also tag @oncall-sre for visibility

maya: creating ticket RW-9273 with logs and artifacts: https://tickets.redwood/9273

owen: bisect finished — single commit d4e5f6 reproduces regression. opening PR to revert batching tweak with notes.

liam: thanks owen. doing local diff to double-check.

maya: next steps: revert in canary, add e2e test that pins sequence distribution to exercise batching, and add perf regression alert for baseline p95 change > 10% on smallbatch.

sam: I'll add the alert. tagging @prod-leads

maya: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket and assign follow-ups.
